speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Insufficient Intake Jaundice)

The weight gain of only 134 grams over two weeks is significantly low, indicating inadequate milk intake despite exclusive breastfeeding. The timing of onset (day 2-3) and the clinical picture strongly suggest this is due to insufficient caloric intake rather than breast milk incompatibility. Please ensure the baby feeds 8-12 times daily and consider a temporary supplement if weight gain does not improve.
